biggest_catch: Both accounts must stay open and in good standing for 60 days, and a referral form must be completed - otherwise no reward.
catches: Referrer: Advanz Credit Union member 18+; employees and volunteers are not eligible.
Referrer chooses one perk per qualifying referral; the cash option is a $25 deposit: 'Get $25 deposited into your account after 60 days. No limit on how many deposits you can earn.'
Alternative referrer perks: +0.25% APY on a special 13-month CD or -0.25% loan discount (limited to one use per referral; only the $25 deposit may be selected for multiple referrals with no limit).
Friend must: meet membership requirements, open a new account, complete a referral form; both accounts must remain open and in good standing for the first 60 days.
The $25 deposit is credited after 60 days; perks may be redeemed up to 60 days after the new account opens.
Referrers may not be listed as a joint owner on the new member's accounts; the friend may not be a current member or have been a member within the past 12 months.
Deposits may be taxable as interest income reported on IRS Form 1099-INT; program subject to change or termination at any time.
